final: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(s.site_ram) AS avg_site_ram_gb, AVG(s.site_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM (SELECT st.zoneregistry, st.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS site_ram, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.entrystat) s GROUP BY s.entrystat
